spans.text: As I thought, this base still contains functional Paradeus units.
416, have 9 and Gr G11 come up here. I'd say the enemies on this side have all been wiped out.
Thanks for the support.
You're welcome. Where's the control panel? We need to open the gate right now.
You'd think they'd be at least show us a little concern, wouldn't you?
Since when was it in my place to care about how Task Force DEFY is faring?
How does 404 perceive those of us on Task Force DEFY, I wonder?
More robust than a tank. At the very least, they don't need to be babied by fragile little civilian Dolls like ourselves.
Now where is that control panel?
Over here, and here's the encryption dongle.
Thank you. 416, go activate the control panel.
Got it.
I mean, we're all Dolls here, so why is there such a huge cognitive bias? How positively bizarre.
Won't you say something? Your words carry the most weight here, you know.
I only have two mags left.
As humorless as ever.
Still, that's just like you.
45, you made it... Whoa!
Who's that lying on the ground?!
Oh, this was our original Commander.
Well, he's passed out now, and about as much use as a tiger with a broken spine, so I took over command.
RPK, your leadership is far worse than Mr. K's.
Otherwise, we wouldn't be stuck in this control room.
Dolls can't replace humans, after all. Not even someone like this.
So this is K. I've only ever heard his name in combat logs.
What about the rest of DEFY?
Where's Ange?

We were ambushed by S.F. during our mission and got separated from them during our withdrawal. Our original commander took a bullet, but before he passed out, he ordered us to hold this position and wait for you.
I've finished activating the gate controls.
Open the gate, then. 9, contact the Commander.
Okie-doke!
Sync the path you took out of the base with us. We need to find Ange and the rest of DEFY.
You're planning to charge in there while you're so lightly armed?
I commend your courage in throwing yourself into the fray like a moth to the flame.
For the sake of the mission, how about letting AK-15 go with you?
I only have two mags left.
But that's not a problem for you, is it?
Oh... I see, you don't want to run into 12, is that it?
I appreciate your concern, but we're not used to other Dolls joining us on ops either.
Please sync the route to us and we'll set off right away.
Griffin's forces will link up with you shortly. Our Commander will provide you with support.
Ehhhh... Alright then. I've sent the data over. Good luck. You'll need it.
